name: Evolve a word
lesson: Twelve random strings of letters evolve toward HELLO by selection, crossover and mutation alone.
lookFor: With this seed the best string matches all 5 positions (HELLO) for the first time in generation 65. The average starts at 0.42 matches, and diversity falls from 0.97 to 0.39 by then, as the population fills with similar strings. Another seed would take a different number of generations: this is one run of a random search, not a promise.
